contract.purpose: Render a product-specific finished marketing closing that helps visitors reach support, privacy and the truthful install or release path, with explicit optional updates and assistant handoff.
contract.canonicalPurpose: The iOS landing factory helps prospective app users understand one focused app and reach its real support, privacy and gated install path through product-owned content, screenshots and status.
contract.audience: Prospective users of one focused Significant Hobbies iOS/macOS app.
contract.job: Use the original CTA and native product routes on the left; editable AI and actual updates on the right; personalized art followed by one studio line.
contract.thesis: Implement selected Precise: compact Geist navigation, Geist Mono category labels, open AI and updates, product-native signature bleeding into original art, final full-width studio line.
contract.system: Precise applies only to the closing footer; Living Memory Book remains the landing composition. Geist UI and Mono role labels inherit native semantic colors.
contract.signature: Each product keeps its native name and colors; an original product-specific panoramic scene follows the readable closing, with a smoothly faded native wordmark.
contract.risk: Shared cross-origin loader/fonts are not deployed yet; browser/CSP/font/phone crop qualification remains unknown under the existing browser-policy block.
contract.qualityBar: Actual licensed font assets; readable14–18px links,16px controls,12px+ labels, real supported weights, coherent paired typography and product identity. Reference inspiration without copied brand/art/claims.

productContinuity.reason: Factory source keeps native product names, semantic colors, original screenshots, support/privacy links and real CTA/release status. Native operating applications are out of scope. Integrated browser rendering remains unknown under the existing policy block.
